name: California Move
north_star: Live in Los Angeles County in a Disney role by March 2027. Activate the move only when a pathway is professionally authorized and financially executable.
human_source_of_truth: Google Sheet: Lane California Move Command Center
completion_criteria: Lane, Klein and Tilly are established in Los Angeles County.
The Orlando house branch is executed and closed out.
The first normal California paycheck has landed.
Arrival stabilization is past its first 90 days.
on_completion: Set status to complete. Every rule whose owner_scope is program:california_move retires automatically.
Enduring preferences, domain guardrails and the decision log survive - they belong to Lane, not to this program.
Open future_review rules (Tundra ownership, California housing permanence) move to their owning domains.

gates.name: Research readiness
blocked: listing the Orlando house on the strength of an application alone

gates.name: California housing executable
requires_all: lease timing aligned to employment transition

deferred_actions.deferral_reason: Lease terms must follow final worksite, start date and office cadence.
Quotes are free before the trigger; deposits are not refundable after it.
An interview or application is not authorization.
Year one is rental infrastructure, not a forever-home decision.

deferred_actions.action: Liquidate brokerage to pre-fund the move
deferred_actions.deferral_reason: Long-term investments are not the core Launch Fund source; size the real requirement first.
Current plan is to drive it; re-evaluate ownership after 3-6 months of real California parking, fuel and commute.
Choir first; expansion is a first-90-day decision, not a move-week one.

launch_fund_ladder.label: Minimum launch floor
launch_fund_ladder.meaning: Enough to activate a move under favorable employer-support conditions. Original headline goal; a floor, not the budget.

launch_fund_ladder.label: Common physical-move requirement
launch_fund_ladder.meaning: Housing at move-in, household move, road trip, setup and contingency.

launch_fund_ladder.label: Base transition requirement
launch_fund_ladder.meaning: Common move plus Orlando overlap and basic prep.

launch_fund_ladder.label: House-branch requirement
launch_fund_ladder.meaning: Adds the landlord reserve and PM fees if renting, or seller-specific cash if selling.

launch_fund_ladder.label: Comfort target
launch_fund_ladder.meaning: Execute without relying on windfalls or the emergency fund. 15% cushion over the branch requirement.
